caption: The drawing consists of a large, scalloped-edged, circular object centered on a beige background. The circular object has a thick, undulating rim with repeating convex and concave sections. Near the bottom left corner, two smaller outlined drawings depict vertical side views of ornamental, fluted objects resembling legs or supports with rounded and curved profiles on wide, ridged bases. In the bottom right corner, two additional outlined drawings show: one, a circular top view with indented edges, and the other, a side elevation of the circular form supported by four decorative, curving legs, with dimensions marked "10 3/4". The entire drawing is constructed in fine gray pencil lines, with careful shading to indicate form and depth, and all illustrations are enclosed by straight, rectangular guide lines. The color throughout is a monochrome combination of light beige paper and gray pencil.
title: Silver Salver
